test_title: PYST 8: SSC MTS 2023 - Reasoning (Held On: 05 Sept, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, 'ETHOS' is coded as '15' and 'CHEERFUL' is coded as '24'. What is the code for 'CHIMNEY' in the given code language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic : Number of letters within the given word are multiplied by (3).

So,

 
• 'ETHOS' is coded as '15'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ecb0e7d898114fe2364319a02eec8905d3173fa5bd08bac105e68d9164766a80.png] 

And, 

 
• 'CHEERFUL' is coded as '24'

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/95042ff88da6cda82fe76c6a1d39fb1a2fc40ed07df78554fdc9abc07e902400.png] 

Similarly,

 
• 'CHIMNEY' is coded as:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/46788b6ee1c50ecb334744b639f819835118315f4c4b11f08bfc1a0a1ee98f37.png] 

Hence, "21" is the correct answer.
